decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TGA777-02. Received: 6th June 2016. TGA777-01 Rev D. Received: 19th July 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction (including shrubs and planting) to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - The material used to in the construction of the hereby approved parking area shall be made of porous hard bound materials, or provisions made to direct run-off water from the hard standing to a permeable or porous area or surface within the site, and shall be permanently retained as such.
Condition : 5 - The proposed new shrubs as shown on plan number TGA777-01 Rev D shall be permanently retained as soft landscaping and shall not be replace with hard standing at any time.
description: Creation of vehicular access to the flat
